messages:
ben: Quick flag — preflight eval gate flagged a regression on the summarizer prompt set for release 2026.04.2. Can we hold the canary until we decide pin vs rollback?

deploy-bot: Canary deployment for release/2026.04.2 paused by eval-gate (rule: prompt-suite-summarizer, delta: -12.4%).

carla: I pulled the failing samples. Mostly hallucination increase + truncation on longer docs. I can share 6 repro prompts.

alice: Thanks. How customer-facing is this change? Any exposed user flows?

carla: The summarizer is used in Notes-export (B2B) and the new meeting-summary beta. Beta users may see poor summaries but core API still returns — quality drop is noticeable.

frank: Repro looks like quantization path for this model variant. Could be model+quant mismatch on prod kernel.

frank: Quick diff: local eval uses q4_k_m, prod used q4_k. Trying a local run with q4_k to match prod.

ci-bot: preflight-evals/job/2026.04.2 reported 8 failing tests, linked: https://ci.internal/runs/88937 (logs attached).

ben: Options: 1) pin traffic to previous model version (2026.04.1) for canary and continue rollout, 2) rollback full release, 3) hotfix model variant rebuild. Thoughts?

dave: If it's a quant/kernel mismatch, pinning the model runtime -> older model: low blast radius and fast. Rollback whole release is heavier.

erin: Product judgement: we prefer pin canary and keep release window open to investigate. Need PM + QA + SRE sign-off to resume.

alice: Agree with pin. What's the timeline to get a rebuild/hotfix if needed?

frank: If we confirm quant mismatch, rebuild + re-quantize could be 2-3 hours dev time + 1h validation, but we should not block other fixes.

carla: QA can validate a pin to previous model quickly — confirm metrics restore within 30m.

ben: I'll initiate model pin for canary now. Will route 100% canary traffic to model:v2026.04.1 in region-us-west-2.

deploy-bot: Action: applying traffic split. Updating service inference/canary: set model_id -> v2026.04.1.

deploy-bot: Traffic change applied. Canary now routing to v2026.04.1.

carla: Running quick re-eval against pinned canary...

carla: Re-eval results: prompt-suite-summarizer delta now +0.3%. Looks good.

alice: Product approves resuming rollout for non-canary traffic? We still need an explicit decision for full rollout.

erin: Not for full rollout yet. Keep canary pinned while eng investigates root cause. We can resume controlled rollout after hotfix or verified rebuild.

ben: Understood. I'll create a follow-up ticket and assign frank to investigate quant/kernel. Ticket: INF-3124.

ben: Also updating release notes draft: "Canary traffic temporarily pinned to prior model version while we resolve an eval regression in the summarizer prompt set."

frank: On it. Will attach debug logs and quant traces to INF-3124.

dave: SRE: monitoring alert set for response latency and error rate. I'll keep an on-call watch for the next 4 hours (change window).

alice: Approvals: carla QA (approved), erin Product (approved), dave SRE (watching/ack). Please react with :+1: when done.

carla: +1

erin: +1

frank: +1

ben: Thanks team. Leaving canary pinned. Will update thread with root cause and next steps.

deploy-bot: Note: release window open until 2026-04-02T22:00Z. Canary pin will remain until cleared by release owner.

ben: Closing loop: next update by EOD or earlier if hotfix ready.

carla: (reacted :eyes:)

frank: Logging initial hypothesis in INF-3124 now.

ben: last call: anybody object to this approach?

alice: No objections from PM.

dave: No objections from SRE.

ben: OK, marking canary hold + pin applied.
